limitations: This is a mixed-modality collection, not 200 questions all requiring both modalities. All 100 immediate questions are audio-grounded; most delayed questions remain visual. Modality is therefore confounded with response group.

100 immediate questions are new; 100 delayed questions derive from existing visual annotations and were rechecked with audio context, including 4 joint audio-video revisions. Do not count shared videos/events as independent data when merging versions.
Audio verification used local ASR and same-model evidence-clip re-transcription, not direct listening. Transcription errors remain possible.
The assistant read full transcripts and had prior visual context. Review is self-review, not independent blind review. Only logged native frames were freshly opened.
One-second decision sampling cannot establish continuous persistence between observations or exact source-frame onset.
Question-only, subtitle, audio-only, color and edit-template ablations were not run. Annotation checks do not establish absence of shortcuts.
Full-video ASR is annotation-only and may contain future decoder context. For causal models, decode video/audio only up to current_time; rerun streaming/prefix ASR if ASR is an input.
This export does not modify the model, train a checkpoint, or add an audio encoder to a video-only Stage3 pipeline.
